name: AWeber
description:
AWeber is an email marketing platform for small businesses, creators, and entrepreneurs. This connector lets you work with your AWeber account directly in Claude without tab-switching or copy/paste.

Ask Claude to draft a broadcast and it writes the copy and saves it to AWeber as a draft, ready for you to review and send. Ask who joined your list last week, or which subscribers carry a specific tag, and Claude searches your lists and answers. Ask how your last send performed and Claude pulls the opens, clicks, and delivery stats.

What you can do:
* Draft and review broadcasts, and check stats on ones you've already sent
* Look up, add, update, and move subscribers between lists
* Search by tag, sign-up date, or activity

_published_faq.name: How do I add AWeber to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AWeber to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.aweber.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AWeber MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AWeber lists 13 MCP tools, including add_subscriber, create_broadcast, get_broadcast, get_broadcast_stats, get_broadcasts, get_list_tags, get_lists, get_signup_form_guide, get_subscriber, move_subscriber, search_subscribers, and send_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AWeber?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AWeber in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
AWeber requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AWeber is developed by AWeber. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
